abilities.name: Brother Serjeants
abilities.effect: If a Group of Military Order Knights is within 6", any Group with this Ability ignores its Morale Penalties when making Morale Checks.

abilities.name: Devoted Faith
abilities.effect: The Group ignore their Morale Penalties when making Morale checks.

abilities.name: Multi-task
abilities.effect: A Turcopolier and his Command Group may switch weapons during the same round.

abilities.name: Squires
abilities.effect: If a Group of Military Order Knights within 6" suffers a casualty, the Squires may make a Morale Check. If successful, remove one Squire instead (adding a Morale Penalty to them). This may be repeated if the Knights suffer several casualties, each one requiring a separate Morale Check. This Ability may only be purchased as an upgrade by a Group of Mounted Sergeants.

abilities.name: Turcopolier
abilities.effect: Cannot start the game as your Retinue Leader but may become the Retinue Leader if the original one is removed from play and a successful Morale check is made.

equipment.name: Composite Bow
equipment.effect: RANGED - 20" Long range, 6" Short range. MOVE AND SHOOT - Can move 3" and shoot at short range. RECURVE BOW - Targets wearing Mail suffer a -1 modifier to Defence rolls.

commandGroupUpgrades.name: Scout
commandGroupUpgrades.effect: After both sides have finished deploying, one Group within Command range may immediately make a normal Move action. While the Scout is alive, the Turcopolier’s Command Group ignores the effects of Exhaustion.
